name: 2019-2c-parcial1
title: Ada's Coffee Shop Rewards
description: A coffee shop sales system rewards customers with combos priced by customer type (Gold/Silver/Normal) according to the volume of coffee bought. The student must remove duplication in the given tests and replace the ifs on product and customer-type symbols with polymorphism, keeping the 14 tests green.

design.notes: Products and customer types are plain symbols (#Combo1, #Gold...) compared with = in several places; the student must turn them into collaborating objects (product and customer-type hierarchies) and also refactor test duplication with setUp/helper methods without changing behavior.
